about.title: About
about.what: Sept Mers replaces the paper score sheet during a game of Skull King. It does not play, does not advise, and does not track the cards played.
about.offline: It works fully offline and makes no network request after the first load — except table sharing, which only opens by hand.
about.trademark: Sept Mers is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Grandpa Beck's Games, Inc. Skull King is a registered trademark of its respective owner.
about.rulesRewritten: The rules text presented here is an original rewrite.

home.how.title: How it works
home.how.step1: Set the table: who is playing, and in which seating order.
home.how.step2: Before each round, everyone calls the number of tricks they expect to win.
home.how.step3: Once the round is played, enter the tricks won and the bonuses. The app does the maths.

about.what.title: What the app does
about.install.title: Install the app
about.install.body: Installed, it opens like an app, with no address bar, and stays there even in airplane mode.
about.install.done: The app is installed on this device.
about.install.ios: On iPhone and iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy: No account, no server, no analytics. Games live in this browser and only leave it through an export you trigger yourself.
about.privacy.share: Table sharing is the only exception, and only opens on purpose: the game state travels encrypted from phone to phone. Matchmaking goes through public relays, which see the phones' IP addresses without seeing the game.
about.privacy.host: The site's host logs requests, IP addresses included, as any host does.
